messages:
maria_devex: quick idea — propose we add a tiny unified telemetry stub header for SDKs to carry routing + quota hints in one place. avoids multiple headers and reduces mismatch between console & sdk UI.

sam_platform: sketch it? curious what fields you're thinking and how it maps to existing routehint/quota headers.

maria_devex: minimal proto: `X-RW-Stub: v1; route=product-fallback; quota=team:42; sample=0.02`

leo_eng: hm, parsing arbitrary keypairs in a single header is ok but we need strict schema. otherwise SDKs will diverge. also how do we handle binary or base64 blobs for future fields?

claire_prod: console implications — dashboards expect separate tags (route, cost_center, affinity). if we collapse to one header we must surface those as separate metadata in telemetry ingestion. not a fan of opaque strings.

maria_devex: agreed on schema. thinking RFC-like `k=v` list, but we will publish mapping and parsers for py/ts/go. fallback: old headers still accepted during transition.

anna_sre: SLO note — sampling field must be honored by proxies before rate limiting decisions. otherwise we lose accurate token attribution. how do proxies read the stub?

sam_platform: proxies will look up `sample` first; if missing, consult legacy `X-RW-Sample`. plan: proxy shim reads stub and legacy headers and normalizes into internal trace.

leo_eng: that shim sounds fine. big caveat: we cannot break older SDKs that inject only legacy headers. so SDK changes must be additive and backward compatible. propose a 3-phase rollout: opt-in, dual-write, opt-out legacy removal (6 months).

maria_devex: +1 to phased rollout. devex will publish migration guide and sample code. also create small compatibility lib that can be plugged into user apps to translate old -> stub and stub -> old for intermediate versions.

claire_prod: UI work: console ingestion pipeline should parse the stub and create separate indexed fields. will need a migration backfill for last 90 days to preserve historical dashboards.

anna_sre: we should also add a strict validation job in CI for SDKs that ensures header encoding/decoding parity. add fuzz tests for weird char cases.

leo_eng: agree. I'll add tests in go/py/ts client repos. quick example for python shim:```python
def encode_stub(meta):
    return ";".join([f"{k}={v}" for k,v in meta.items()])
```

maria_devex: nice. also request doc with migration checklist: SDK owners, proxy owners, console ingest, infra jobs, rollout flag and timeline. I'll draft and post tomorrow.

sam_platform: deploy-bot — can we schedule a canary for the proxy shim in staging tomorrow 09:00 PT?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: proxy-shim v0.1 -> staging at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z. @sam_platform @anna_sre will be notified on failures. :rocket:

claire_prod: one more: telemetry cost accounting. the `quota` field schema needs to support multiple dimensions `team:val,product:val`. recommend comma-separated pairs and explicit encoding in docs.

maria_devex: good call. I'll include examples and a migration section for `quota` expansions.

leo_eng: final ask — add a feature-flag gate in SDKs so we can flip the new header on per-release. avoids surprises.

maria_devex: yep feature flag + default off for 2 weeks, then opt-in beta teams, then default on. thanks all, will circulate docs + RFC link soon.
